/* ==UserStyle==

@-moz-document domain("geezbook.com") {
@media (min-width: 761px) {
    body:not(.login-mode):not(.mobile-info-page) .brand, body:not(.login-mode):not(.mobile-info-page) .brand:hover, body:not(.login-mode):not(.mobile-info-page) .brand:focus, body:not(.login-mode):not(.mobile-info-page) .brand:active {
        position: absolute !important;
        left: -7px !important;
        top: 6px !important;
        z-index: 5 !important;
        display: block !important;
        width: 103px !important;
        min-width: 103px !important;
        max-width: 103px !important;
        height: 31px !important;
        min-height: 31px !important;
        margin: 0 !important;
        padding: 0 1px !important;
        box-sizing: content-box !important;
        border: 0 !important;
        border-radius: 0 !important;
        background-color: transparent !important;
        background-image: url('data:image/png;base64,') !important;
        background-repeat: no-repeat !important;
        background-size: 100px auto !important;
        background-position: 0 !important;
        overflow: hidden !important;
        color: transparent !important;
        font-size: 0 !important;
        line-height: 31px !important;
        text-indent: -9999px !important;
        text-shadow: none !important;
        text-decoration: none !important;
        white-space: nowrap !important;
        opacity: 1 !important;
        filter: none !important;
        outline: 0 !important;
    }

}
